tasks.short: Gather and maintain patient histories and records

steps.what: Gather patient information and clarify histories with patients, relatives and professionals
Draft patient records preserving sources, uncertainty and discrepancies

loop.purpose: Draft record sections from attributed history material
loop.input: History source pack and approved record template
loop.output: Draft history with source links and unresolved discrepancies
loop.check: Psychiatrist checks symptoms, dates, negation, attribution and uncertainty against original accounts
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; unresolved passages are entered manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Unstructured narratives need careful composition beyond field merging

steps.what: Verify and accept the exact patient information and record version

tasks.design: Use the authorised {OTHER} clinical record system to draft a history from attributed material gathered by the psychiatrist. The psychiatrist preserves conflicting accounts and checks clinical meaning before accepting a record version.
tasks.previous_blocker: Narratives from several people require repeated composition and reconciliation.
tasks.enabler_now: Clinical documentation assistants support clinician-validated notes and record integration.
tasks.still_hard: Avoiding invented symptoms, false certainty and incorrect attribution.
tasks.human_edge: The psychiatrist clarifies accounts and determines their clinical relevance.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated composition with full clinical review

reach.learn: How to preserve source attribution across care teams

evidence.claim: Autoscriber supports clinician-validated clinical documentation and record integration; local psychiatric history accuracy still needs validation.
This workflow's time saving is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: OTHER means the existing clinical record system; try authorised native templates and documentation features first.

In s1 the psychiatrist captures patient identity, date, source person/role, source text or reference, relevant history and unresolved discrepancies. Source gathering, permission/access checks and capture remain fully counted in 45%; missing material is sought manually.
No automatic diagnosis, treatment recommendation or external record disclosure occurs.
The workflow uses permitted source material without assuming recording consent or technical access; local arrangements remain unknown.
research_questions: Does assisted composition save time after complete source and clinical checks?

already_counted.description: History gathering, access checks and capture

incremental.description: Template maintenance and additional quality sampling

approvals.approved_version: Exact patient, history text, source attributions, dates and uncertainties; any change requires renewed review

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=89.5, gross=10.5%; minus 5 focal upkeep gives net 5.5%. Range 0-2% allows complex conflicting accounts and existing efficient documentation; E1 scenario.

Team observations are produced by actual care; no automatic progress flags are assumed.
Existing records and communication tools suffice.
